sn36.7:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn36.7:1.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn36.7:2.1: sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya.
sn36.7:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhā domanassaṃ;
sn36.7:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
sn36.7:3.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sato hoti.
sn36.7:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
sn36.7:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno hoti.
sn36.7:4.4: sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya.
sn36.7:5.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati sukhā vedanā; so evaṃ pajānāti;
sn36.7:5.3: sā ca kho paṭicca no apaṭicca.
sn36.7:5.6: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn36.7:5.7: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kāyaṃ paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatī ti.
sn36.7:5.8: so kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati vayānupassī viharati virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
sn36.7:5.9: tassa kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato vayānupassino viharato paṭinissaggānupassino viharato, yo kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya rāgānusayo, so pahīyati.
sn36.7:6.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati dukkhā vedanā.
sn36.7:6.4: sā ca kho paṭicca, no apaṭicca.
sn36.7:6.7: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn36.7:6.8: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kāyaṃ paṭicca uppannā dukkhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti.
sn36.7:6.9: so kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati, vayānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
sn36.7:6.10: tassa kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato vayānupassino viharato virāgānupassino viharato nirodhānupassino viharato paṭinissaggānupassino viharato, yo kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya paṭighānusayo, so pahīyati.
sn36.7:7.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā, so evaṃ pajānāti:
sn36.7:7.3: sā ca kho paṭicca, no appaṭicca.
sn36.7:7.6: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno.
sn36.7:7.7: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kāyaṃ paṭicca uppannā adukkhamasukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatī.
sn36.7:7.8: so kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati, vayānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
sn36.7:7.9: tassa kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato vayānupassino viharato virāgānupassino viharato nirodhānupassino viharato paṭinissaggānu passino viharato yo kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya avijjānusayo so pahīyati.
sn36.7:8.1: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti;
sn36.7:8.2: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti;
sn36.7:8.3: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, sā aniccāti pajānāti, anajjhositāti pajānāti, anabhinanditāti pajānāti;
sn36.7:8.4: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaññutto naṃ vediyati;
sn36.7:8.5: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaññutto naṃ vediyati;
sn36.7:8.6: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vediyati, visaññutto naṃ vediyati;
sn36.7:8.7: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti;
sn36.7:8.8: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānāti.
sn36.7:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya,
sn36.7:9.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya;
sn36.7:9.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vediyāmīti pajānāti.
sn36.7:9.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānātī’ti.
